reasons: Portfolio status domain conflict: PORTMSTR 2100-VALIDATE-PORTFOLIO accepts only 'A', 'I' or 'C' (88-level VALID-STATUS, BR-095), while copybook PORTFLIO used by PORTADD and PORTDEL declares 'A' active, 'C' closed and 'S' suspended (BR-149). 'I' exists only in PORTMSTR and 'S' only in PORTFLIO. GAP-091 also records that the PORTFLIO and PORTMSTR records are linked only by naming convention. (awaiting DR-PORTMSTR-001)

Portfolio status domain conflict: copybook PORTFLIO declares PORT-STATUS values A (active), C (closed), S (suspended) (BR-149), while PORTMSTR validates A, I, C (BR-095). 'S' and 'I' each exist in only one set. PORTUPDT action 'S' moves the new value into PORT-STATUS without any validation (BR-117), so the forward status rule cannot be chosen from the evidence. (awaiting DR-PORTUPDT-001)
